subject: Request: bakeoff top-up eligibility & ops plan (Medlytics)
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@medlytics.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22 09:12 PST
Subject: Request: additional trial top-up for RFP bakeoff

Hi Hannah / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We kicked off the internal bakeoff this morning (Medlytics vs TitanAI / CloudGen) and ran into heavier than expected token usage when we pushed a realistic workload. Team asked whether Redwood can provide a one-time top-up to make sure we can finish the benchmark without throttling — roughly an extra 750k tokens.

Two asks:
- Can you confirm eligibility for a top-up tied to this RFP bakeoff (we’re still evaluating but want to complete parity tests)?
- If yes, what does the ops flow look like (timeline, any PO or paperwork)?

I attached our usage export and the test schedule. We’re on a hard deadline to present results on Nov 30.

Thanks — appreciate quick visibility.

Jordan Lee
Head of Data Science, Medlytics
jordan.lee@medlytics.ai
[Attachment: medlytics-usage-report.csv (csv)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@medlytics.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22 10:03 PST
Subject: Re: Request: additional trial top-up for RFP bakeoff

Jordan —

Really appreciate the context and the usage export, that helps. Short answer: we can typically approve timeboxed top-ups for bakeoffs when there is a clear competitive matchup and a defined deliverable (presentation date / evaluation criteria). I’ve sketched a proposed ops plan below:

1) Eligibility check (sales) — confirm customer is in active bakeoff & identify competing vendors.
2) Ops + Finance review — validate usage, set top-up size and expiry (we usually set 14 days).
3) Credit issuance — platform team applies top-up to account; we send confirmation email.
4) Guardrails — rate limits and quota caps unchanged; we log tokens to separate "bakeoff" ledger for auditing.

Proposed recommendation for Medlytics: 750k token top-up, expires 2026-12-06, with a short note in the deal record that this is conditional on completion of the bakeoff and a follow-up brief.

Ben / Monica — can you confirm operational feasibility and any paperwork (SOW / credit memo)? If ops needs a smaller tranche (e.g., 250k increments) we can stage it. Jordan — if you prefer a staged release, mention cadence; otherwise I’ll request full 750k.

Hannah
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22 11:15 PST
Subject: RE: Request: additional trial top-up for RFP bakeoff

Looks doable from an ops perspective. A few notes:
- We can apply a one-time platform credit (non-refundable) scoped to the Medlytics account.
- Default expiry policy is 14 days; we can set a custom expiry if Sales needs it extended, but that requires sign-off from Finance.
- I recommend staging: 250k now (to unblock tests) and 500k on evidence of continued consumption (we can automate a quick usage check after 48 hours).

I’ll prepare the internal ticket and attach the usage snapshot for audit. We will also require a short confirmation email from Jordan acknowledging that credits are evaluation-only and won’t be applied to production usage.

I’m attaching a draft top-up plan (ops fields included) for the ticket.

Ben Carter
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed-topup-structure.pdf (pdf)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@medlytics.ai>
Date: 2026-11-23 08:42 PST
Subject: Re: Request: additional trial top-up for RFP bakeoff

Jordan / Hannah / Ben —

Finance is comfortable approving the 750k token allowance under these conditions:
- Credits marked as "bakeoff_eval" and tracked on DEAL-8472 ledger.
- Expiry date set to 2026-12-06 (no extensions without Finance sign-off).
- Jordan to confirm that any security-sensitive data is redacted from test payloads (standard for evaluation credits).

If Jordan confirms acceptance, I’ll sign off and Ben can push the credits. For transparency, we’ll require a short one-paragraph summary of findings after the bakeoff (can be informal).

Monica Patel
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@medlytics.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-24 14:05 PST
Subject: Re: Request: additional trial top-up for RFP bakeoff

Thanks all — that works for us. Confirm Medlytics accepts the 750k token bakeoff_eval credit scoped to DEAL-8472, expiry 2026-12-06, and we will redact any PII from benchmark inputs.

We’ll start with the 250k tranche now and request the remainder after the first 48-hour run; Hannah, I’m fine with you triggering the staged release when you see the usage check pass. We’ll deliver a brief summary of results by Dec 1.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Jordan
